label: Concurrent-actualization controls checked
description: Existential inertia (the extrinsic no-change account) falsifies concurrent actualization and satisfies the other premises of the derivation; an intrinsic persistence power and a relay of givers falsify concurrence; without received esse the reception bridge fails; each premise of the derivation and of the immensity composition is needed in one interpretation; the weak sustaining reading and the weak concurrent actualization are strictly weaker than their strong versions; all premises hold together with both conclusions in one interpretation. A finite countermodel shows a premise is needed in that interpretation, not that it is false. Model claims concern these interpretations only.
